<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware\Auth;

use App\Models\Core\Staff\SidestStaff;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

// V2: Staff-only gate. Checks supabase_uid maps to a SidestStaff record.
class EnsureSidestStaff
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        // Set by VerifySupabaseJwt middleware
        $uid = $request->attributes->get('supabase_uid');

        if (! $uid) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Unauthenticated'], 401);
        }

        $staff = SidestStaff::query()
            ->where('auth_user_id', $uid)
            ->first();

        if (! $staff) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Staff access required'], 403);
        }

        // Attach for controllers to use
        $request->attributes->set('sidest_staff', $staff);

        return $next($request);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Middleware\Auth;

use App\Models\Core\Staff\SidestStaff;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

// V2: Admin-only gate. Requires staff record with role=admin.
class EnsureSidestAdmin
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $uid = $request->attributes->get('supabase_uid');

        if (! $uid) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Unauthenticated'], 401);
        }

        $staff = $request->attributes->get('sidest_staff');

        // If EnsureSidestStaff ran before this, we already have the staff record
        if (! $staff) {
            $staff = SidestStaff::query()->where('auth_user_id', $uid)->first();
        }

        if (! $staff || $staff->role !== 'admin') {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Admin access required'], 403);
        }

        $request->attributes->set('sidest_staff', $staff);

        return $next($request);
    }
}

// V2: Staff-triggered data export. Same DataExportService as self-service —
// only difference is the recipient resolution path. send_to=staff requires
// admin role (data exfiltration to a Side St inbox). Default send_to=professional
// (the safer mode) is allowed for any staff role.
class StaffDataExportController extends ApiController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DataExportService $exportService,
    ) {}

    public function store(
        RequestStaffDataExportRequest $request,
        Professional $professional,
    ): JsonResponse {
        /** @var SidestStaff $staff */
        $staff = $request->attributes->get('sidest_staff');

        // send_to is validated by RequestStaffDataExportRequest; default is 'professional'.
        $sendTo = (string) $request->query('send_to', 'professional');

        if ($sendTo === 'staff' && $staff->role !== 'admin') {
            return $this->error('Only admin staff can receive exports directly.', 403);
        }

        try {
            $audit = $this->exportService->dispatch(
                professional: $professional,
                triggeredBy: 'staff',
                staffId: $staff->id,
                sendTo: $sendTo,
            );
        } catch (DataExportInProgressException $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'An export is already in progress.',
                'existing_export_id' => $e->existingExportId,
            ], 409);
        } catch (NoRecipientEmailException) {
            return $this->error('No valid recipient email on file.', 422);
        }

        return $this->success([
            'export_id' => $audit->id,
            'status' => $audit->status,
            'recipient_email' => $audit->recipient_email,
            'send_to' => $audit->send_to,
            'professional' => [
                'id' => $professional->id,
                'handle' => $professional->handle,
            ],
        ], 202);
    }
}

## Plain English

The staff access system now has formal role definitions that prevent accidental escalation in code. Previously, the word "admin" was scattered as a raw string in multiple files, making it easy to mistype or forget a check. Now there are named constants (`ROLE_SUPPORT`, `ROLE_ADMIN`) and a dedicated `isAdmin()` method, so the role check is always done the same way. Any route can now declare `middleware('staff:admin')` directly — no need for a separate admin middleware alias — which makes it easier to add new fine-grained roles in the future.

## Technical Summary

**Files changed:**

- `app/Models/Core/Staff/SidestStaff.php` — Added `ROLE_SUPPORT = 'support'` and `ROLE_ADMIN = 'admin'` constants plus an `isAdmin(): bool` helper method.
- `app/Http/Middleware/Auth/EnsureSidestStaff.php` — Added variadic `string ...$roles` parameter to `handle()`. When roles are passed (e.g., `middleware('staff:admin')`), the middleware enforces the role check after authenticating the staff record. Also updated to check request attributes first before querying the DB (eliminates double lookup on admin routes where both `staff` and `staff.admin` run).
- `app/Http/Middleware/Auth/EnsureSidestAdmin.php` — Replaced `$staff->role !== 'admin'` magic string with `! $staff->isAdmin()`. No behavior change.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Api/Staff/ProfessionalSiteManagement/StaffDataExportController.php` — Replaced inline `$staff->role !== 'admin'` with `! $staff->isAdmin()`. No behavior change.
- `tests/Feature/Staff/EnsureSidestStaffMiddlewareTest.php` — New: 5 tests covering no-restriction passthrough, role match, role mismatch (403), missing UID (401), and multi-role acceptance.

**New contract:** `middleware('staff:admin')` is now equivalent to the existing `staff.admin` alias; both remain valid. The `staff.admin` alias (EnsureSidestAdmin) is preserved for backward compatibility.

## Decisions Made

The `EnsureSidestAdmin` middleware was kept intact rather than removed. Routes in `routes/api/staff.php` already use `staff.admin` and changing them would widen the blast radius unnecessarily. The parameterized approach (`staff:admin`) is additive — new routes can use it, old routes keep working.

The "attributes-first" DB lookup optimization was included because the `EnsureSidestAdmin` middleware already did this pattern, so aligning `EnsureSidestStaff` was a natural consistency fix.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The `??` operator on `$request->attributes->get('sidest_staff')` gives a zero-cost early exit in tests (pre-injected staff skips the DB query) and also removes the actual double-query in production when both `staff` and `staff.admin` middleware run on the same request — a small but real win that required no extra code.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

All 1230 tests pass. Committed as `51272ff`. The implementation adds `ROLE_SUPPORT`/`ROLE_ADMIN` constants and `isAdmin()` to `SidestStaff`, makes `EnsureSidestStaff` accept optional role parameters (`middleware('staff:admin')`), and eliminates magic `'admin'` strings from both the admin middleware and the data export controller.
